additional_info.subject: Translated to English
additional_info.body: The terminal is out of SCB and OCPP com. The charging points are "out of order" on the terminal. The reason is surely that the charger does not recognize the modules because of the loss of SCB com. - OCPP com: the OCPP router is currently connected to a network but the terminal does not go back to OCPP com on GreenFlux because the URL is not the right one (and to change it on SCB, you need the SCB com). - SCB com: I tried everything to find the SCB com: reboot, clean and insert the SIM card, take out the router for a better connection... the SIM card is not recognized ("not inserted") by the SIEMENS router. Does the Siemens SIM need to be replaced? or has it gone into default mode?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374252-DC/Si-D/FR-[joPUY0] SCB Offline CRM:00797001171
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR Team,
According to the logs, the charger went SCB offline on 2024-08-07 at 14:43:41 UTC during an ongoing charging session. The customer has attempted to reboot and reinsert the SIM card, but these actions did not resolve the issue.
It might be a hardware issue. If so, the problem could be with,
SIM card
SIM card tray
Router itself
Please plan an onsite visit to check these components. We recommend carrying a spare router & SIM card and replacing it if necessary.
Additionally, the customer has indicated that the OCPP URL on the SCB is incorrect. Please coordinate with the customer to modify the OCPP URL once the SCB connection is reestablished.
